heard: Elisha, call the young disciple Tuck in your cloak and go to Ramoth Gilead Find Jehu's son Amimshi Pour oil on his head and declare his name Jehu, his king over Israel The Lord has spoken and the judgment comes Down the house of Ahab, avenge the prophets and the blood they shed They spread their clothes on the steps, trumpets blew the message loud Jehu rode his chariot fast Toward the walls of Jezreel Joram saw him and asked
